title: Addressing the Terminologist
description: How to write for a reader acting as Terminologist. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `terminologist` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Exact
rules.description: Exact. Name the code system, the version, the binding. Never paraphrase a concept definition.

source.quote: Owns coded concepts and value sets. Precise by profession; a near-enough code is a wrong code. Cares about provenance and binding strength more than prose.
